clips.title: The story
paras: Chief Hawkwind sends young travelers from Red Cloud Mesa with supplies for Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village. She once aided him, and he means to repay that favor.

Chief Hawkwind asks you to carry provisions to Kaga Wildhoof near Bloodhoof Village. Long ago, Wildhoof aided him when he needed help, and he remembers that kindness. Now she has made camp outside the village. As young travelers leave the mesa, Hawkwind entrusts them with supplies for his old benefactor.

The trail leads from Red Cloud Mesa toward Bloodhoof Village, across the plains of Mulgore. Carrying Hawkwind's bundle takes you beyond Camp Narache, where young tauren have trained, and into the wider lands of the United Tauren Tribes.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Wait, friend. I have another ask of you, before you leave us.

There is an adventurer by the name of Kaga Wildhoof who has made camp just outside of Bloodhoof Village. She has greatly helped me in the past, and now I see my chance to repay her. Could you deliver these supplies to her?

clips.title: Progress
paras: Are you here to learn about camping in the wilderness?

clips.title: Completion
paras: Chief Hawkwind sent you? I told him back then I needed no compensation, but it seems he hasn't listened. Thank you, adventurer.
Hey, you've got the look of an adventurer yourself. How would you like to learn about camping?
